title: SKE Crystal Pro Pink Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pods offer a seamless way to enjoy the brand’s bold and refreshing flavours without the waste and expense of disposable vapes. Each prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt e-liquid, ensuring a smooth and satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape with rapid nicotine relief. Pink Lemonade blends the bright, zesty tang of lemonade with a subtle red berry sweetness, creating a perfectly balanced citrus vape with a slightly fizzy finish. The result is a smooth yet lively flavour that refreshes with every sweet puff. Swapping pods is effortless—simply remove the empty pod and pop a fresh one into place. Whether you’re looking for a cost-effective alternative to disposables or a convenient way to continue enjoying your favourite SKE Crystal Pro 600 flavours, these prefilled pods provide a mess-free and flavourful vaping experience.
